entries.code_description: Other sports and recreational sports services
entries.comment: Tabel I prov. b.3 and b.14, f: the granting of (physical) access to spectators of sports competitions, demonstrations and the like. Sports competitions are events where people actively participate in sports. Sports demonstrations are, for example, shows of the Harlem Globetrotters (basketball), performances of the Spanish Riding School (horse dressage) and shows of Wrestlemania (wrestling); use of sporting facilities.
